Uhhh alright let's see, there's a few
that skin hits a certain key because i love the "lonely for reasons youd never understand" aesthetic

- Semmelweis: Key support for Bloodtithe (HP Loss) team after her Euphoria, the team's primary DPS is Nautika who is a Limited but she reruns during next Anniversary.
- Marsha: Most versatile sustain in the game, powerful shielder with Crit and DMG Dealt buffs. Dispels debuffs, has a bit of [Burn] if you want to ever build Lingering Glow team (dont' recommend tbh).
- Charon: Goated support and BiS for the Dynamo team (and also the driving force behind Dynamo Wheelchair). Massive Crit buffs, execute mechanic, requires effectively no actions. Only problem is that the Wheelchair's sustain (Enigma) is not going to be on the standard banner for a bit.

- J: Ridiculously powerful support/dps/sustain for the Riposte team (but can be used solo) post Euphoria. He does a bit of everything, offensive buffing, high damage output and massive shields. Does require Euphoria which is endgame stuff and he's dogshit without it.
- Flutterpage: The single most meta support for over a year (until Rhiannon releases next Anniv). Very action friendly, massive Follow-Up buffs, action economy buffs, really dumb op.

- Not a very high recommend but you could go for the Twins: They have good damage for early game and will carry you through to the endgame even without a team. They have a VERY weird playstyle due to their archetype but the bonus is that: Rhiannon is the leading pull target next Anniv and BiS for Twins, Coppelia is BiS for Twins and you get her for free during anniv and Everecho releases in the patch after Anniv. Kind of like playing the long game but I wouldn't consider it the worst for a new player? Just know that the Twins are lowkey dogshit at endgame for now.
> Additional bonus is that they have a really cool banner.

I think the main chase you might want to consider is Dynamo Wheelchair. During Anniv there's also a banner for Ms Stranger who is one of the strongest DPS in the game and her best team is Dynamo Wheelchair, it's just goofy that Enigma is restricted rn so you'd want Ulrich and Charon to make Dynamo work.
